name: Exec Cluster E10: Indicator Exits — Chandelier, Chande Kroll, PSAR
description: Tests: chandelier_exit direction as signal, chande_kroll_stop as trend filter, psar as stop-and-reverse
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E10: Indicator-Based Exit Signals
# Tests: chandelier_exit, chande_kroll_stop, psar as signal sources
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === INDICATOR EXIT SIGNALS ===
# Chandelier Exit — ATR trailing stop indicator
ce = chandelier_exit(length=22, atr_length=14, multiplier=2)(high, low, close)
is_uptrend = ce.direction > 0

# Chande Kroll Stop — two-step volatility-adaptive stop
cks = chande_kroll_stop(p_period=10, q_period=20, multiplier=3)(high, low, close)
cks_uptrend = cks.long_stop > cks.short_stop

# PSAR — stop-and-reverse
sar = psar(acceleration_factor_step=0.02, acceleration_factor_maximum=0.2)(high, low)
sar_bullish = crossunder(sar.result, close)
sar_bearish = crossover(sar.result, close)

# === USE CHANDELIER DIRECTION AS PRIMARY SIGNAL ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=is_uptrend, short_entry=not is_uptrend)

# Fixed sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=25)

# ATR-based stop
atr_val = atr(high, low, close, 14)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 3)
